description: This file defines a PHP class 'SMTP' that implements SMTP protocol functions for sending emails, including connection, authentication, message transmission, and command handling, compliant with RFC 821.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: A PHP class implementing SMTP protocol functions for email communication, including connection management, authentication, message sending, and command execution.

methods.name: SMTP
methods.description: Constructor initializing SMTP class properties.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SMTP server.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication with username and password.

methods.name: Connected
methods.description: Checks if the SMTP connection is active.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the SMTP connection.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Sends email message data to the SMTP server.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Requests the server to expand a mailing list.

methods.name: Hello
methods.description: Sends HELO/EHLO command to initialize SMTP session.

methods.name: SendHello
methods.description: Sends HELO or EHLO command.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Requests help information from the SMTP server.

methods.name: Mail
methods.description: Starts mail transaction with sender address.

methods.name: Noop
methods.description: Sends NOOP command to keep connection alive.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Terminates SMTP session.

methods.name: Recipient
methods.description: Specifies recipient address.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the SMTP session.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message using SMTP.

methods.name: SendAndMail
methods.description: Sends a message or mail to a recipient.

methods.name: Turn
methods.description: Placeholder for TURN command, not implemented.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies if a name is recognized by the server.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from SMTP server response.
